name: Supermaven
description: Supermaven is an AI code completion tool built for speed, featuring a 1 million token context window that allows it to understand your entire codebase at once. It uses a custom Babble architecture trained specifically for code completion, delivering suggestions noticeably faster than GPT-4-based tools. Supermaven integrates as a VS Code extension and JetBrains plugin, and was acquired by Codeium in 2024.
